build_super_resolution_wrapper: build a SuperResolution wrapper that upsamples low-res images and concatenates them with high-res input for diffusion training
create_super_resolution_with_bicubic: create a SuperResolution adapter using bicubic interpolation mode to upsample low-res conditional inputs
test_super_resolution_forward: test the SuperResolution forward pass with a low-res image in conditional_inputs and a diffusion timestep
refactor_super_resolution_clamp: refactor the SuperResolution class to clamp upscaled low-res values between min_val and max_val thresholds
review_super_resolution_interpolate: review the SuperResolution forward method that interpolates low-res images to match target resolution before concatenation
